mapper.select: SELECT faq_id AS faqId, category, sub_category AS subCategory, question, answer, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt FROM faq WHERE 1=1 AND (category = #{category} OR sub_category = #{category}) AND (question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR answer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, title, type, is_pinned AS isPinned, view_count AS viewCount, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt FROM notification ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
